newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan university teachers end 90-day strike.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan university teachers end 90-day strike.

text.p: Venezuelan university teachers voted on Friday temporarily to suspend a long strike over pay increases, union leaders said.
About 40,000 professors walked out on Jan. 15, leaving most of the country's 400,000 university students idle.
Classes were expected to resume on Monday but union leaders said they intended to keep the pressure on the government to ensure that promised wage raises were granted.
"We're resuming classes, as a change of strategy only," said a spokeswoman for Fapuv, the umbrella organization for 17 university professors' unions.
The government has offered a 65 percent pay increase and other benefits. Fapuv initially asked for a 125 percent hike.
The stoppage was the longest in a series of public sector strikes in the past six months in Venezuela, where years of high inflation and recession have slashed wages to 30 percent of 1980 levels.
